scope: Actual text composition from a focusable native child, enabled by a separate default-off device-local consent alongside preview/action consent. This is not merely navigation to the main application.

The child receives only a bounded verified channel label and opaque compose grant, never existing chat history, account keys or target identifiers. Explicit compose-button hit validation creates it; same-grant label updates do not steal focus.

The trusted application renderer revalidates owner, login generation, current target and SendMessages permission, then uses the normal messageStore encryption/send path with an explicit origin server. Source guards propagate through API options, including refresh redispatch; no plaintext fallback was introduced.

Drafts remain in child memory, clear only on confirmed sent or explicit discard/session teardown, and failures retain text with an unknown-delivery warning. Enter, Shift+Enter and IME behavior are covered. No automatic send retries occur.

Native correlation enforces exact composer/main frames, bounded text, one in-flight request, five-second timeout and 64 non-evicted request IDs per grant. Valid close events reach the app main renderer and rotate the grant/budget. Revocation, account/route changes and full-frame composer reload retire the old grant.
This slice covers currently viewed text server channels only; other conversation types and real-device acceptance remain open.
